rules.prepare:
if [ ! -f "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/include/sys/reg.h" ]; then cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" sed -i '/#include <sys\/reg.h>/d' src/coredump/_UCD_lib.h fi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-nls \ --disable-tests
